codebook_feedback: No topic covers kidneys, urinary tract or liver (6a638cf5), nor anemia (69f4ca1a). 'Should I do X' about a habit's safety (drinking after surgery, 69d51123) fits R3 only weakly; it is not relief-seeking. R6 sign 'Is there a supplement or vitamin that has' overlaps R3 when supplements target named conditions (69f4ca1a). Messages listing conditions across T10/T6 plus a supplement focus (T2) need more than one secondary (69f4ca1a). Emotional 'why am I anxious' questions are not clearly R1 (6a0206ae). Mixed T1 visit + T5 malaise (695be8c6) has no close-call rule. T7 does not say whether medicine-related sleep issues in a child override medication topics (6144ea17).
